replies.author: Arachadonic
replies.body:
Sorry for the double post but I am having one small issue with YAML. When settings the spawns, the YAML seems to want 4 variables. The first one is X then Y than Z (I assume) but what is the 4th?

Example its like this:
746.5,126,-152.5,90,0
replies.body_tagged:

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
It is the direction, where the players look at,
  • 0 = South, 0 degrees
  • 1 = West, 90 degrees
  • 2 = North, 180 degrees/-180 degrees
  • 3 = East, -90 degrees
